# The Best Mowers UK

> Independent UK lawn mower buying guides and reviews. Research-led recommendations built from published manufacturer specifications, verified owner reviews and UK retail pricing, across cordless, electric, petrol, robot, ride-on and hover mowers from every major UK brand.

## Power-type guides
- [Cordless lawn mowers](https://thebestmowers.co.uk/cordless-lawn-mowers/): UK buyer's guide with top picks, brand comparison and FAQs
- [Electric lawn mowers](https://thebestmowers.co.uk/electric-lawn-mowers/): Corded mains-powered mowers under £200
- [Petrol lawn mowers](https://thebestmowers.co.uk/petrol-lawn-mowers/): For lawns over 500 m² and rough conditions
- [Robot lawn mowers](https://thebestmowers.co.uk/robot-lawn-mowers/): Set-and-forget mowers for medium UK gardens
- [Ride-on lawn mowers](https://thebestmowers.co.uk/ride-on-lawn-mowers/): For lawns over 1000 m²
- [Hover lawn mowers](https://thebestmowers.co.uk/hover-lawn-mowers/): Float-on-air mowers for slopes and banks

## About
The Best Mowers is an independent UK publication. We do not run a test lab. Recommendations are built from published manufacturer specifications, verified owner reviews on Amazon UK and retailer sites, and UK pricing data, cross-checked against each other; where a figure is the manufacturer's claim rather than an independent measurement, we say so. Rankings weigh cut quality, battery and runtime for the garden size in question, weight, build and value at UK prices. We earn affiliate commission on qualifying purchases, but no manufacturer pays for placement and commission never decides the order of a list. See our [affiliate disclosure](https://thebestmowers.co.uk/affiliate-disclosure/).
